name: open meeting history panel via selector

actions.comment: Was a bare goto plus `click .hist-toggle`. `.hist-toggle` does not exist anywhere in the codebase — the meetings history panel is toggled from the hq-bar View menu, and the panel's own classes are `.hist-panel` / `.hist-head` / `.hist-row`. The page is also behind the auth + setup gates now.

expect: The Meetings panel toggle is checked in the hq-bar View menu. When meetings exist the `.hist-panel` is expanded showing rows with status dots, an X dismiss button on completed rows, and a 'Clear N read' button in its header. With no meetings recorded the panel stays hidden by design.
